title: The wall is coming down
dek: Renting micro-VMs, buying Mac minis, wiring serverless functions — every agent setup today fights the same wall: isolation that costs you a machine. A workbook carries its own.

title: Your secrets never touch the OS
dek: Give an agent the operating system and you've given it your keychain, your env vars, your everything. The fix isn't more rules — it's an agent that never gets the OS in the first place.

title: Software you can hold
dek: An app, a database, a sandbox, and the agents that keep it building — all in one file you can send. What it means when the unit of software is something you hold in your hand.
